entries.title: Tower Crane and Swinging Load Yard
entries.description: A tall rotating tower crane picks up colored box “steel beams” from stacks, swings them with visible arc trails, and gently drops or accidentally collides them with a partially built frame whose beams attach, detach, and bounce if misaligned.

entries.title: Road Paving Conveyor Line
entries.description: A line of dump trucks slowly moves and backs up to a paver machine that pours a flowing, slightly transparent asphalt surface that spreads, levels, and cools from orange to gray while rollers behind compress it and leave smooth black trails.
